name: Bilt Card

apr.notes: APR not visible on product or terms page; see cardholder agreement for current APR.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee not stated on fetched pages.

credit_required.notes: Bilt does not publish minimum score requirements.

rewards.redemption_notes: Bilt Points redeemable via 28 airline and hotel transfer partners (1:1 ratio), Bilt Travel Portal, future rent/mortgage payments, Lyft rides, fitness classes, statement credits, eligible student loan payments, and toward a home down payment.

benefits.title: No transaction fee on rent, mortgage and HOA
benefits.description: Every Bilt Card lets you earn rewards on rent and mortgage payments made through Bilt with no transaction fee. Bypass landlord credit card fees via ACH, Venmo, PayPal, or check.

benefits.title: Bilt Neighborhood Dining bonus points
benefits.description: At Bilt Neighborhood Dining restaurants — 20,000+ participating locations — you earn bonus Bilt Points per dollar on top of your card's standard earn rate. No activation required.

benefits.title: Lyft bonus points
benefits.description: Linking Bilt and Lyft accounts earns an additional 2X Bilt Points per dollar on eligible rides, on top of the card 1.0 base rate. On the Bilt Card 2.0 Blue card the total is 3X.

benefits.title: Bilt Travel Portal bonus points
benefits.description: Booking hotels earns +2X and flights +1X bonus Bilt Points on top of your card's base rate through the Bilt Travel Portal.

benefits.title: 28 airline and hotel transfer partners
benefits.description: Points transfer at a 1:1 ratio for Bilt travel partners, including major domestic and international airline programs and leading hotel loyalty programs.

notes: Legacy Bilt Card 1.0, issued by Wells Fargo. Discontinued: Bilt states that the Wells Fargo Bilt Mastercard (card 1.0) could be used through 2026-02-06 and was retired after that date, and that all card 1.0 cards were deactivated on 2026-02-07 when the Bilt Card 2.0 lineup went live — Bilt Blue (us-column-bilt-blue, $0 annual fee), Bilt Obsidian (us-column-bilt-obsidian, $95/year) and Bilt Palladium (us-column-bilt-palladium, $495/year), all issued by Column N.A. and serviced by Cardless. The earn structure recorded here is card 1.0's: 3X dining, 2X travel, 1X on other purchases and 1X on rent (capped at 100,000 points per calendar year). The live Bilt card pages now describe the 2.0 lineup, so the pre-launch product page is cited via its 2026-01-15 Internet Archive snapshot. APR and foreign transaction fee were not visible on the fetched card 1.0 pages (honest nulls); the 2.0 tiers charge no foreign transaction fee. The image published at the old image URL is a Bilt Card 2.0 marketing banner showing the three 2.0 cards rather than the card 1.0 Wells Fargo Bilt Mastercard, so image.url is nulled and the API serves the generic fallback art.
